inputs.lyrics:
**Tempo:** Upbeat, energetic synth-pop or rap-rock
**Vibe:** Triumphant, tech-savvy, and hyped
### Verse 1
My GPU is sweating, the fans are screaming loud
Another model dropped today, the biggest in the crowd
They say you need a flagship card just to run the base
I’m staring at my laptop, tears running down my face
The VRAM’s never high enough, the error messages pop
I thought I’d miss the future, I thought I’d have to stop
### Chorus
But wait, who’s that uploading in the middle of the night?
It’s **AI With Chucky**, bringing back the light!
Whenever new models drop and the hype is getting thick
He’s got the free Colab notebooks, ready with a click
No credit card required, no hardware left to fry
Chucky’s giving out the keys to the AI sky!
### Verse 2
From ComfyUI workflows to the latest RVC
Background removal, video gen, he makes it all so free
He breaks down all the nodes, explains the open source
Guiding all us beginners right along the course
While others gatekeep secrets or charge a premium fee
Chucky drops the GitHub links for folks like you and me
### Chorus
Oh, who’s that uploading in the middle of the night?
It’s **AI With Chucky**, bringing back the light!
Whenever new models drop and the hype is getting thick
He’s got the free Colab notebooks, ready with a click
No credit card required, no hardware left to fry
Chucky’s giving out the keys to the AI sky!
### Bridge
Hit the bell, smash the like, the notification rings
Kaggle links and local installs, the magic that he brings
We don’t need a massive rig to generate the dream
We just need the workflow and Chucky on the stream!
### Outro
Yeah, the models keep on growing
But the tutorials keep flowing
Shoutout to the channel that never lets us drop
**AI With Chucky**, taking us straight to the top
Run the first cell... wait for the green tick...
And we’re live. Peace!
